_comment: Fixed per-theater facts, keyed by the name DCS-gRPC's GetTheatre returns (docs/adr/0079, 0085). Read once at startup, never written by code (P5); a copy in state/theaters.json overrides it theater by theater, field by field. utcOffsetHours: local = Z + offset, standard time, no daylight saving, which is how DCS keeps time. Syria +3 is a squadron decision, [SOURCE-DEFINED] (decisions.md H11); every other offset is MOOSE's UTILS.GMTToLocalTimeDifference() (DCS community source, not the guide). transitionAltFt: below it altitudes read QNH, at and above it flight levels. Syria 10000 is a squadron decision (H62); every other value is [SOURCE-DEFINED], kept at the 18000 every theater used before, and should be checked against that region's AIP. tmCentralMeridianDeg: the central meridian of the theater's DCS Transverse Mercator projection, for grid convergence (true = grid + convergence); mirrors tools/miztoyaml/projection.py. A theater without it has unknown convergence, so DCS grid headings there cannot be turned into true or magnetic. magneticVariation (optional, none shipped): {"fixedDeg": n} replaces the World Magnetic Model with one value for the whole map, {"offsetDeg": n} adds a squadron correction to the model. East positive. Without it, variation is WMM2025 at the position and mission date (H69). terrainExtent (optional): the DCS map rectangle in its own metres, {"xMin", "xMax", "zMin", "zMax"} (x north, z east), for npm run terrain:build (docs/adr/0133); a theater without it cannot be built. The values are pydcs dcs/terrain/<map>/<map>.py `bounds = mapping.Rectangle(top, left, bottom, right)` (top/bottom are x, left/right are z; master @ 55dc18adbd6907ea17d87de559445c4f9bc39146). defaultTransitionAltFt: what a theater this table does not list gets, the 18000 every theater used before H62; it is the only source of that number (DATA-2).
